name: Mr. Wazlow
source: The boss of Sunny Shine Funland. Mr. Wazlow is a kind boss that is very busy with all of the paperwork and phone calls he has to deal with. He is usually at his office. If something goes wrong, he will punish them accordingly. He also has a greedy side to him.
